text: - Android: ran `--platform kotlin` cleanly (apps/android/.../uniffi/ConceptReads.generated.kt) but the Rust half had to be hand-authored (crates/nmp-chirp-android-ffi/src/uniffi_app_loop/concept_reads.rs) — AppHandle guards its NmpApp pointer behind `Session::with_app` (a UAF-prevention closure), which the codegen's direct-accessor emitter can't target. Matches the registry's declared shape exactly so the generated Kotlin wrapper works against it unmodified. `ui/NoteSocialCounts.kt` mirrors the iOS lifecycle via `LaunchedEffect`+`try/finally`.
